title: Juicy Fatty Egyptian Lamb Kebabs
description: A nostalgic Egyptian dish featuring lamb, turkish delight, and pickle, this recipe is a unique blend of flavors, and is buddhist-temple-friendly as it does not contain any animal by-products or alcohol.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the lamb, turkish delight, pickle, onion, garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Thread the lamb mixture onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 10 minutes per side, or until the lamb is cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with additional turkish delight and pickle if desired.
Traditionally, these kebabs are served with a side of rice or flatbread.
To add some extra flavor, try serving the kebabs with a dollop of tzatziki sauce.
